1879053062.name: Oathbreaker's Shame
1879053062.desc: Increases the damage you and your companions deal to the foe.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>This effect does not stack with other potent Incoming Damage effects.</rgb>

procEffects.description: DNT - Being Hit reduces the cooldown of Last Stand
Scoring a Critical Hit causes your target to take 2% more damage for 10s. This effect stacks with Telling Mark and Oathbreaker's Shame.
DNT - Being Hit reduces the cooldown of Last Stand
DNT - Being Hit reduces the cooldown of Last Stand

1879064070.name: Sudden Defence
1879064070.desc: Gain a protective morale shield defending you against incoming damage.\n\nBubble strength is 35% of the targets' Max Morale pool before other bonuses apply.

1879064198.name: Song of Restoration
1879064198.desc: A song that makes an ally's heart glad again, removing some of the evil that currently plagues it.

1879099270.name: Mentor: Bagpipes
1879099270.desc: You can instruct someone how to play the bagpipes.

1879113094.name: Lucky Strike
1879113094.desc: Roll the dice with an attack that applies a damaging Red gamble to the target.

1879132038.name: Muster in Ost Guruth
1879132038.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Ost Guruth in the Lone-lands.

1879172998.name: Clear Defeat
1879172998.desc: Removes tier 4 dread obtained from defeat.

1879198342.name: Friend of Large Hunters (Dusky Sabre-cat)
1879198342.desc: Summons a sabre-tooth cat companion.\n\nThe sabre-tooth cat hails from the north and can wield the cold of its home.

1879202182.name: Shield Bash
1879202182.desc: A smashing attack with the shield that can stun an enemy.

1879214342.name: Battle Memory
1879214342.desc:
This allows a Warden to store a gambit for later, letting them use it without having to build it.

<rgb=#00FFDD>This skill requires the Potency effect.
Potency is triggered by the improved versions of Defensive Strike, Deft Strike and Goad. Once potent, the next Gambit used will replace Battle Memory.</rgb>

<rgb=#FF7700>Potency is consumed and replaced by a potent version of your next successfully executed Gambit.</rgb>

   <rgb=#00FF00>Cost: % of Max Morale Equal to the Number of Icons used to build Gambit</rgb>

1879218438.name: Improved Story of Courage
1879218438.desc:
Removes one Poison, Fear, Disease, or Wound from nearby fellows.
Protects against further Fears.

Removes additional Fear effects in a small area around your target.

1879222022.name: Nature Spirit (Spirit Mote)
1879222022.desc: Summons a spirit companion.\n\nThe Spirit of Nature can greatly aid in restoring the Morale of your fellows.

1879231366.name: Ranged Unerring Strike
1879231366.desc: A targeted strike that is very difficult to avoid and deals potent damage for a long time.

procEffects.description: When enemies Block, Parry, or Evade your attacks, you have a chance of quickly following up from another angle, dealing:

1879239558.name: Spread of Arrows
1879239558.desc: Steadying yourself on your War-steed, you release several projectiles toward your target.

1879260038.name: Improved Quick Shot
1879260038.desc: Nock and loose an arrow quickly.\n\nHas a chance to generate additional Focus.

1879262982.name: Goading Strike
1879262982.desc: You strike, not necessarily to deal damage, but to goad your foe into attacking you. You will be ready for their next attack and your strategy helps you and your allies reduce incoming damage.

1879263622.name: Lay Trap
1879263622.desc: Your skill in combat and experience with trapping allow you to lay snares on the go. You throw down a trap behind you that will last for a short period of time or until triggered by an enemy.

1879276550.name: Demoralizing Shout
1879276550.desc: Your enemies quake, their morale shattered from your pronouncement.

1879291398.name: Hero's Strike
1879291398.desc: A melee attack that increases the effects of healing on yourself.\n\nRestores your Morale.

1879319174.name: Vicious Claws: Hide
1879319174.desc: A savage attack that deals damage to your enemy, interrupting their action.\n\nGenerates threat.

1879342470.name: Steed of the Unflagging Dragon
1879342470.desc: A steed from the 10-year Anniversary Festival.

1879358086.name: Council's Arrow
1879358086.desc: The justice of the Elves is often delivered at the tip of an arrow.

1879387910.name: Muster in Hultvís
1879387910.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Hultvís.

1879457542.name: Cauterizing Steel
1879457542.desc:
A series of precision strikes hit your opponent with a red-hot weapon where already wounded.

This skill will consume any Power Attack, Mighty Blow, or Unerring Strike damage over time effects on your target, dealing bonus damage for each effect consumed.

<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

conditionalEffects.description: The Cauterizing Steel Gambit line will apply a 10% Incoming Healing debuff to the target. Stacks once.
The Cauterizing Steel Gambit line will apply a 10% Incoming Healing debuff to the target. Stacks up to 2 times.
The Cauterizing Steel Gambit line will apply a 10% Incoming Healing debuff to the target. Stacks up to 3 times.

1879458182.name: Ferocious Battle-kitten
1879458182.desc: Summons a ferocious battle-kitten to accompany you on your journeys.

1879458694.name: Hammer-stroke
1879458694.desc: Strike your foe with a powerful melee attack, which you follow up by assuming a defensive posture.

conditionalEffects.description: Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 3%.
Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 6%.

1879466246.name: En Garde
1879466246.desc:
Refresh your Steady buff and prepare for combat.
This skill can only be used while in Steady Balance.

<rgb=#FF7700>Swordplay:
 Thrust deals more damage.
 Blade Shield gives more Parry chance.</rgb>

1879479302.name: Icy Expeditions Sheep
1879479302.desc: Summons a wintry sheep to accompany you on your travels.

1879495302.name: Memory of Fellowship
1879495302.desc: A Memory of Fellowship can be used to inspire your allies, reminding them of their bonds and helping them to resist evil.

1879515014.name: A Wisp of Shadows
1879515014.desc: As you reminisce upon your time lost in the deepest shadows, a fragment of darkness breaks away from your own shadow to trouble you for a short while.\n\nNo doubt this is just some trick of the eyes, an illusion sown by your own lingering doubts and fears.

1879523206.name: The Effigy of The Grim Southron
1879523206.desc: Summon an effigy of The Grim Southron, doomed to die shortly after it appears.
